data.name: Jayshankar
data.gender_notes: Jayshankar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaya means victory, Shankara is the name of Lord Shiva. This name signifies the victory of Lord Shiva. It is a powerful name often used for boys in Hindu tradition. The name Jayshankar carries the meaning “Victory of Shankara” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayshankar usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of shankara and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jayshankar signifies the triumph of the divine over the material world. It represents the inner strength and wisdom to overcome challenges and live a virtuous life.
data.etymology: Jayshankar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of Shankara.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayshankar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Jayashankar, also known as Jayashankara Bhupalam, was a 17th-century king of the Nayaka Dynasty of Madurai in southern India. He ruled from 1639 to 1659 and was a staunch patron of arts and culture.

Jayashankar Prasad was a 20th-century Indian polymath, scholar, and freedom fighter. He was born in 1888 in Bihar and died in 1967. He made significant contributions to the fields of mathematics, physics, and philosophy.
